fact: The Master Plan states a total financial resource requirement of Ksh 484.241 billion for 2022-2032 (Table 6.1, by theme and year) and names the ICT Authority, under the Ministry of ICT, Innovation and Youth Affairs, as its main coordinating and implementing agency.
title: The Kenya National Digital Master Plan 2022-2032
publisher: Ministry of ICT, Innovation and Youth Affairs (hosted by ICT Authority)
